description: The plot illustrates the mean interclass similarity for different conditions, plotted against relation category. The x-axis is labeled “Relation Category” and spans from 0 to 60 with a tick label interval of 10. The scale is linear. The y-axis is labeled “Mean Interclass Similarity” and ranges from 0 to 0.5 with a linear scale and a tick label interval of 0.1. There are six lines in the plot. The first line is blue, solid, and labeled “w/o DPO obo”; it begins at approximately 0.158 at x=0 and ends at approximately 0.107 at x=60, exhibiting multiple peaks and declines across the range. The second line is orange, solid, and labeled “w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint”; it begins at approximately 0.107 at x=0 and ends at approximately 0.086 at x=60, with a peak around x=10 at approximately 0.28. The third line is green, solid, and labeled “DPO”; it begins at approximately 0.086 at x=0 and ends at approximately 0.086 at x=60, with a more relatively flat trajectory. A blue dashed line represents the “Average of w/o DPO obo” and is horizontal at y=0.158 across the entire x-axis. An orange dashed line represents the “Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint” and is horizontal at y=0.107 across the entire x-axis. Lastly, a green dashed line represents, “Average of DPO”, horizontal at y=0.086 across the entire x-axis.
